title: VisAlign: Dataset for Measuring the Degree of Alignment between AI and Humans in Visual Perception
reasoning: The paper defines AI alignment as aiming to align models with human-intended goals, preferences, or ethical principles. It explicitly frames AI-human visual alignment as a subcategory of AI alignment, aiming to guide AI to resemble human behaviors and values for the safe use of AI. The proposed reliability score metric directly evaluates a model's 'safety' and 'trustworthiness' based on the 'consequences of the model's decision' and 'cost of an incorrect prediction', which are ethical considerations for AI deployment.
